title: Mayor and Council’s New Year’s Eve Levee and Skate
summary: Ring in the New Year with Mayor and Council for an evening of celebration, skating, and fireworks! Join us on December 31 for Mayor & Council’s New Year’s Eve Levee & Skate.
description: Ring in the New Year with Mayor and Council for an evening of celebration, skating, and fireworks! Join us on December 31 for Mayor & Council’s New Year’s Eve Levee & Skate. Enjoy a family-friendly skate at the Multi-Purpose Trail from 4-6 PM followed by food trucks, enjoy fiery entertainment, and free hot beverages (while supplies last) in Memorial Park from 6-7 PM. Fireworks start at 7 PM. This free, outdoor event runs rain or shine and offers something for everyone to enjoy as we welcome the New Year together. Parking is available in nearby parking lots at the Leisure Centre and across from Latcham Hall.
